cpi_note: 2025 CPI annual average uses 11 of 12 months: BLS collected no October 2025 data (lapse in appropriations).

care_cost.label: Adults who could not get medical care when needed because of cost
care_cost.description: Rates of adults that forgo needed medical care due to cost for the civilian non-institutionalized population 18 years and over.
care_cost.title: Percent of adults who could not get medical care when needed due to cost by Total (2011 to 2024)

bills.label: People who had trouble paying off medical bills in the past year
bills.description: Rates of individuals who had trouble paying off medical bills during past twelve months for the civilian non-institutionalized population.
bills.title: Percent who had trouble paying off medical bills in the past year by Total (2019-2024)

drugs.label: People prescribed medicine who changed it because of cost
drugs.description: Rates of individuals who were prescribed medication in the past twelve months who made changes to medical drugs because of cost during the past twelve months for the civilian non-institutionalized population. This includes delaying filling a prescription, taking less medicine, or skipping medication doses to save money.
drugs.title: Percent who made changes to medical drugs because of cost in the past year by Total (2019-2024)

burden.label: People in families spending more than 10% of income on health care, premiums included
burden.description: Share of individuals who are in families where out-of-pocket spending on health care, including premiums, accounted for more than 10 percent of annual income for the civilian non-institutionalized population.
burden.title: Percent of people with a high medical cost burden by Total (2017 to 2024)

oop.label: Median family out-of-pocket health spending, premiums included
oop.description: Annual median family medical out-of-pocket spending, including premiums, for individuals in the civilian non-institutionalized population. Out-of-pocket" (OOP) is the term used to describe the costs of health care that are not covered by health insurance but paid for out of an individual's own resources. These costs include premiums and medical expenses not covered by their medical plan  including copays for doctor and dentist visits  diagnostic tests  prescription medicine  glasses and contacts  and medical supplies."
oop.title: Median Medical Out-of-Pocket Spending by Total

out.urban_note: Credit bureau data from August 2025. Share of people with a credit record who have medical debt in collections. Excludes states whose laws restrict reporting of medical debt on credit reports.
